hooks.name: Optimize images with sips before commit
hooks.description: Uses macOS sips to downscale images exceeding 1920px before they are committed to git

action.prompt: When committing image files (png, jpg, jpeg) to git, first check their dimensions using `sips -g pixelWidth -g pixelHeight`. If any image exceeds 1920px on its longest side, resize it down to fit within 1920px (maintaining aspect ratio) using `sips --resampleHeightWidthMax 1920` before staging it. This keeps the repo lean without sacrificing usable quality for presentation slides.
